name: synesthetic-chat
description: Colors, highlights and letter shapes in Claude's replies, following the looks you set in the Synesthetic Layer app's Editor: numbers, dates, IDs, links and warnings, nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs, and your Word Bank.

mode.title: Style
mode.description: a = colored text, b = highlight chips, c = combined (the app's Editor overrides this once its looks are synced)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Which palette to draw for: dark or light backgrounds (the app's Editor overrides this once its looks are synced)

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: default, or cb for the color-blind-safe palette (the app's Editor overrides this once its looks are synced)

grammar.title: Grammar words
grammar.description: on = nouns tinted, verbs bold, adjectives italic, adverbs italic and underlined; off = only numbers, dates, IDs and the other pattern types

off.title: Categories to turn off
off.description: Comma-separated category names to skip, for example: number,name,adverb
